Some orphans live in special places, called ‘orphanages’ !. Some of
these orphanages are very bad.

Copperfield. And another writer, Charlotte Bronté, writes about
Jane Eyre, a girl orphan.

Sometimes life is dangerous, especially for poor people. It is easy
to die in an accident in a factory or on a farm. Doctors and
hospitals are not very advanced®. Parents often die young from
diseases. It is dangerous for women to have children. Women
often die in childbirth®,

Fire!

back to Australia. They make a plan.

London,

But one day, take Magwitch with you. Row to the end of the
Thames where it meets the sea. Catch the ship to Hamburg, Then
g0 to Australia. Then Magwitch is safe.

Joe to the Rescue

Now, there is a big problem. The police say: ‘We must hang
Magwitch. He is a criminal.’ But Magwitch is very ill. He is
dying. Pip is visiting him in prison,

happy?

MAGWITCH: I hope you are happy soon, Pip. Goodbye, I don’t have a

another country. Pip owes money to the shopkeepers. They
are very angry with him and take him to a house. If he
wants to be free, he must pay the money.

love you,

Estella!

‘Australia. I want to work hard and forget my problems.
